back.es: I'm very well, thanks. And you? (informal you)
back.example: How are you? I'm very well, thanks. And you?

note: The informal hint is needed because it rules out "¿Y usted?", and the explicit "I'm" in the prompt is what makes "Estoy" required rather than the equally common shorter "Muy bien, gracias. ¿Y tú?".
